valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (egyptianmediaproductioncity) is served under two keys, EGS78021C010.CA PE is withheld on the issuer's own figures (the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 11.43 against price over EPS 10.85) and the filing doe...) while MPRC PE 11.69; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
